_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics (1% breakout rate) demand HOLD as base rate, and the analyst's divergent factors (ETF flows at 0, funding at 52) prevent trusting the bullish bottom analog until institutional validation returns.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call HOLD on current phase, but split on interpretation: analyst sees distribution risk while narrative sees accumulation setup; forward direction not agreed.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND VIX compresses below 50 AND BTC 30d momentum turns positive
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain below 10 AND funding climbs above 60 AND BTC 30d change goes negative
